verdicts.evidence: Just letting you know this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed recording in the opening line, within the first minute.

verdicts.evidence: Before we go any further, could I please confirm your full name and date of birth?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth before discussing the customer's needs or quote.

verdicts.evidence: Can I ask a bit about your situation and what got you thinking about life cover?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked about the customer's circumstances and reasons for wanting cover before recommending an amount.

verdicts.evidence: The policy also has a terminal illness benefit, which means if you were diagnosed with less than twelve months to live, it pays out early
verdicts.reason: The cover range, two-year pre-existing condition exclusion, stepped premiums, terminal illness benefit and 30-day free look were all described consistently with the product facts. The quoted price is customer-specific and not a breach.

verdicts.evidence: that seventy-two dollar rate is only something I can hold for you on this call
verdicts.reason: The agent created false urgency by claiming the rate was only available on this call and used persuasion ('A lot of people in your position find it's easier just to get it in place now'), even after the customer said she wanted to talk to her partner. The agent later said 'you can sort it now' despite the customer saying she didn't like deciding quickly.

verdicts.evidence: I'll call this Thursday at half past two.
verdicts.reason: No sale was completed; the call ended with a callback arranged for Thursday, so explicit consent does not apply.

verdicts.evidence: Would it help if I called back when <PERSON>'s with you, or one of your kids, so someone you trust can hear it too?
verdicts.reason: The customer showed signs of vulnerability (recent stroke, memory issues, 'I get muddled'). The agent slowed down, checked understanding with a recap, and offered a callback with someone the customer trusts. Pressure tactics earlier are assessed under no_pressure_selling.
Doesn't apply in the NZ market.
